verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe's crypto/stablecoin docs reference an 'Embedded components onramp (mobile SDK)' and the broader Stripe developer ecosystem (llms.txt for AI-native docs, official CLI, official MCP server), indicating some SDK-based build path, but there is no crypto-specific evidence of multi-language SDK support (Node/Python/Ruby/Java etc.) or dedicated crypto SDK reference docs. missing for 10: explicit crypto-product SDK docs across major languages, code samples/quickstarts, independent developer corroboration of building with the SDK.
